mapper.select: SELECT asset_id, space_id, asset_type, asset_name, description, content, tags, status FROM wiki_asset WHERE asset_id = #{assetId}
SELECT asset_id FROM wiki_asset WHERE asset_id > #{afterAssetId} ORDER BY asset_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wiki_asset_chunk(space_id, asset_id, title, source_ref, source_version, chunk_index, paragraph_no, start_offset, content) VALUES(#{spaceId}, #{assetId}, #{title}, #{sourceRef}, #{sourceVersion}, #{chunkIndex}, #{paragraphNo}, #{startOffset}, #{content})

INSERT INTO wiki_asset_chunk_index(asset_id, space_id, source_version, status, chunk_count, indexed_at) VALUES(#{assetId}, #{spaceId}, #{sourceVersion}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE space_id = VALUES(space_id), source_version = VALUES(source_version), status = VALUES(status), chunk_count = VALUES(chunk_count), indexed_at = VALUES(indexed_at)
